title: Placental Organoids Development: Application in the Study of the Human Reproduction Pathophysiology.
official: Placental Organoids Development: Application in the Study of the Human Reproduction Pathophysiology.
summary: Placental organoids represent an in vitro 3D reconstruction model of the human placenta and of its complex cellular organization to evaluate the pharmacological effect in terms of placentation, gene expression, protein synthesis and placental secretomics.
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
